title: Kyuubiki synchronous operator task request budget
description: An execution_budget envelope outside the signed TaskIR. Agent queue and RPC waiting limits do not prove remote termination. Budgeted dispatch does not replay after send or receive failure; connection failures before dispatch may still fail over. Native HTTP waiting has one monotonic total budget equal to these phases plus 10000 ms, with a 64 MiB response limit. These limits do not govern local solver CPU termination or whole multi-step batches.

queue_timeout_ms.description: Agent capacity waiting budget in milliseconds. Runtime decoders require an integer encoding, not a numeric string, boolean or decimal encoding.

request_timeout_ms.description: Agent RPC response budget in milliseconds; progress/heartbeat frames do not renew it.
